title: Total Expenses
subtitle: Paid project spending
notice: Only recorded payments count. Unpaid balances, unconfirmed historical costs and Kharchi are excluded.
noProject: Select a project to view paid spending.
denied: You do not have permission to view Total Expenses.
failed: Could not load paid spending. Try again.
datesInvalid: Choose a valid start and end date.
paymentNotice: Confirm historical payments explicitly. Only recorded payments count in Total Expenses.
costMissing: Record the purchase total before recording a payment.
paymentInvalid: Enter a positive amount within the remaining balance and a valid payment date.
reasonRequired: A reason is required to void a payment.
paymentFailed: Could not save payment. Try again.
uncertain: Outcome uncertain. Retry the same command before making another change.
legacy: Legacy classification: review for duplicate costs before confirming payments.
trackingUnavailable: Payment recording is unavailable. Ask your administrator to enable payments, then refresh.
paymentInactive: Payments can only be recorded for an approved expense in an active project.
paymentDenied: Your project access does not allow recording payments.
paymentSettled: There is no remaining balance to pay.
paymentStale: This record changed. Refresh and review its latest balance before recording another payment.
materialNotice: Current all-time quantities and balances. Period filters apply to paid totals above. Estimates and order costs are separate from payments; deliveries do not create payments.
materialsEmpty: No material requests for this project.
unpricedOrders: Some purchases have no recorded total. Complete their costs to see the order cost and balance due.
